related.title: MySQL InnoDB：鎖順序與 deadlock 圖
related.titleEn: MySQL InnoDB: lock ordering and deadlock graphs
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：重現兩位值班員各自離線後違反至少一人值班的不變量。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce two operators independently going off call and violating the at-least-one-on-call invariant. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 把兩個轉帳交易的等待關係畫成有向圖，找出可避免的鎖循環。
related.differenceEn: Draw wait-for edges for two transfers and identify an avoidable lock cycle.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 各交易寫不同列仍可能因共同讀取條件而衝突；快照隔離不等同 serializable。 教學基準：1+1 = 2 initial on-call count；第二檢核：2-1-1 = 0 unsafe final count。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
當交易互相等待對方持有的鎖時形成 deadlock；縮短 timeout 不能證明不會發生。 教學基準：1+1 = 2 wait-for edges；第二檢核：2-1 = 1 transactions continuing after one abort。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Transactions writing different rows can conflict through a shared predicate; snapshot isolation is not serializability. Teaching baseline: 1+1 = 2 initial on-call count; second check: 2-1-1 = 0 unsafe final count. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Deadlock arises when transactions wait cyclically for held locks; shorter timeouts do not prove prevention. Teaching baseline: 1+1 = 2 wait-for edges; second check: 2-1 = 1 transactions continuing after one abort. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: SQLite：partial index 與可證明的條件
related.titleEn: SQLite: partial indexes and provable predicates
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：重現兩位值班員各自離線後違反至少一人值班的不變量。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce two operators independently going off call and violating the at-least-one-on-call invariant. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 對少量待處理任務建立部分索引，驗證查詢條件涵蓋索引條件。
related.differenceEn: Create a partial index for sparse pending tasks and verify predicate compatibility.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

部分索引只包含符合 WHERE 的列；planner 必須能證明查詢不會漏掉不在索引內的答案。 教學基準：300*32 = 9600 partial entry bytes；第二檢核：10000*32 = 320000 full entry bytes。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Transactions writing different rows can conflict through a shared predicate; snapshot isolation is not serializability. Teaching baseline: 1+1 = 2 initial on-call count; second check: 2-1-1 = 0 unsafe final count. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

A partial index includes rows satisfying its WHERE clause; the planner must establish that omitted rows cannot be answers. Teaching baseline: 300*32 = 9600 partial entry bytes; second check: 10000*32 = 320000 full entry bytes. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
